elsa (support): customer reports free-trial blocked with message 'account on hold: risk checks failed'. account_id acct_0abc123. requesting manual review to grant limited trial if low risk.
fraud-bot: FLAG: acct_0abc123 flagged -> reasons=[proxy_reputation, disposable_email], ip=45.77.12.9 (Hetzner), score=78, action=hold_free_trial.
elsa (support): repro steps: 1) signup with ryan@tinyagency.co 2) apply promo TRIAL2026 3) UI modal shows hold. server log snippet: `hold_reason=fraud_check_v2:proxy_reputation; rule=TEMP_EMAIL_OR_VPN` request_id=req_0f3a9c.
irene (cs): customer says they're a small digital agency, provided website tinyagency.co and offers to share invoice. email on record ryan@tinyagency.co (looks business). they uploaded an ID to support portal. asking for 14-day trial.
kevin (eng): quick log check: ip=45.77.12.9 -> ASN 200130 (Hetzner). rDNS box12345.hetzner.com. no prior abuse hits on acct_0abc123. promo check failed mainly due to email age (created_at=2026-01-06) but domain tinyagency.co registered 2019. mixed signals.
sam (fraudops): @elsa paste KYC doc link? if ID + invoice look legit, fraud ops will ok a one-time manual grant but block promo. also confirm if they added a card and AVS results.
elsa (support): they haven't added a card yet. uploaded ID link (internal): https://files.redwood.internal/ids/acct_0abc123_ryan_dl.jpg uploaded 2026-03-16T18:12Z. customer on standby for video verification if needed.
fraud-bot: NOTE: recent sessions show ip hops RU -> NL -> US within 24h (likely VPN/rotating proxies). raising risk score.
irene (cs): customer says dev workflow uses a Hetzner devbox/CI. asks if that disqualifies them — they argue business email + ID should be enough. suggests whitelist if we have invoice + GitHub org link.
sam (fraudops): risk ops rubric: if business email domain matches website AND we have government ID OR invoice, approve limited trial: policy = manual_limited_trial (7d, 50k tokens), promo_disabled. require business email confirmation. recommend blocking promo stacking.
elsa (support): proposed action: manual_grant = yes. parameters: duration 7 days, quota 50k tokens, promo_block = true. add audit note with doc links. assign @kevin to apply override.
kevin (eng): I'll run admin override. command: `POST /admin/v1/accounts/acct_0abc123/overrides -d '{"trial":true,"expires":"2026-03-23","quota":50000,"promo_block":true}'` will add audit note. posting override_request_id when done.
fraud-bot: Action recorded -> override_request_id ov_1c9a2; waiting for confirmation after execution.
sam (fraudops): i'll enable monitoring: alert if >10 req/sec from suspicious IP ranges or sudden token spike. also will schedule a 72h check-in.
irene (cs): drafting customer message: 'We approved a limited 7-day trial (50k tokens). Promo codes are disabled for this account. Please share company invoice and GitHub org link so we can complete verification.' i'll send now.
elsa (support): update: message sent to customer, granting manual limited trial pending documentation. closing thread for now — will re-open if further signals. thanks all :pray:
